correctness.rationale: For lengths 1–10, 16-letter substitution blocks and allowed adjacent ancestors {00,01,10} exhaust all factors in just 48 slices. All fourteen scattered-pattern counts follow from a stated exact induction, giving a single third-binomial doubleton at length ten and none earlier; both seed signatures and their order-four distinction are exhibited. For any morphism, every target scattered-pattern count of order at most three is a fixed linear combination of source scattered counts of order at most three; injective substitution preserves distinctness. Thus iterates are genuinely different equivalent factors for every nonnegative power, with no inference from mere finite testing. Independent finite-prefix and integer-recurrence checks corroborate the argument.
